headline: Habagat Forces More Than 13,500 Evacuations in Metro Manila, Brief Reports
seoTitle: Habagat: 13,500+ Evacuations in Metro Manila | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News morning brief reports more than 13,500 evacuations in Quezon City and Pasig as flooding also affected Iloilo City and Oriental Mindoro.
deck: Local evacuations expanded overnight as monsoon rains affected urban river communities and other parts of the country.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News morning package reports 10,368 residents sheltered across 28 Quezon City evacuation sites and 3,189 residents evacuated in Pasig City during overnight monsoon flooding.
The package also reports flooding in Iloilo City and Bulalacao, Oriental Mindoro, with local class and road disruptions.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The figures are presented as locality-specific counts cited by the newsroom package from local disaster and public information offices. They should not be treated as a nationwide displacement total.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Evacuation counts indicate immediate shelter and rescue demand, while flooding outside Metro Manila shows the wider geographic reach of the monsoon episode.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch local DRRM offices and the DSWD for updated evacuation, relief and damage figures as waters recede or rise.
